T.topic_fa: جی‌تی‌ای بیست سال برگرکینگ و مک‌دونالد را با برندهای جعلی مسخره کرد؛ این هفته برگرکینگ همان برگر هفت‌طبقه‌ی تمسخر را واقعی ساخت و برنده‌ی ترند شد
T.topic_en: GTA spent twenty years mocking fast food with fake brands. This week Burger King made the mockery real, and won the GTA VI launch
T.central_tension_fa: با آمدن GTA VI همه‌ی برندها خواستند خودشان را به آن بچسبانند و بیشترشان «موج‌سواری تنبل» خوانده شدند. برنده‌ها کسانی بودند که وانمود نکردند گیمرند: برگرکینگ شوخیِ علیه خودش را پذیرفت و برگر جعلی هفت‌طبقه را واقعی کرد؛ اسپک‌سیورز با شعار بیست‌ساله‌اش «جی‌تی‌ای اشتباهی» را اسپانسر کرد. در لحظه‌ی ترند، چیزی بیاور که فقط از تو برمی‌آید.
T.central_tension_en: When GTA VI landed, almost every brand tried to jump on it, and most got called lazy bandwagoners. The winners didn't pretend to be gamers. Burger King accepted a joke made at its own expense and built GTA's fake seven-patty burger for real. Specsavers sponsored 'the wrong GTA' with a twenty-year-old slogan. In a trend, bring the one thing only you can bring.
T.working_hook_fa: جی‌تی‌ای بیست سال برگرکینگ را مسخره کرد. این هفته برگرکینگ همان مسخره را پخت.
T.working_hook_en: GTA spent 20 years mocking Burger King. This week Burger King served the joke.

key_sources.claim: BK Belgium/Luxembourg HeartWhopper: 7 patties, based on GTA's Burger Shot burger, 'parody of the parody', 2 weeks from Nov 19, one awarded per day for best clip
Agency Happiness Brussels for Burger King Belux; YouTube pre-roll, Shorts, Reddit
Heart Stopper: fictional 7-patty Burger Shot burger seen in GTA IV ads; parodies Big Mac/Whopper

Round-up: Heineken, Mercedes-Benz, Durex, Nescafe, KFC, Specsavers; many posts 'lazy bandwagon jumping'; winners used humour or a plausible product link, didn't pretend to be gamers; Rockstar does few collaborations and parodies ads
Specsavers sponsored GTA Transport Ltd (Leicester haulier); 'not the GTA partnership I originally had in mind, but a deal's a deal' (Neil Liddle)
Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell appeared as real food stands at Miami's Kaseya Center
Netflix, Weather Channel, Miami Heat and many brands joined; GTA long 'an absolute no' for brand deals (figures read via summary extraction: label 'reported')

T.framing_note: Type 2 (viral moment brands jumped on). Spine: (1) GTA invents fake chains to mock fast food — Burger Shot, the 7-patty Heart Stopper; (2) GTA VI arrives 19 Nov, brands flood in, most called bandwagon; (3) Burger King copies the burger made to mock it — 'parody of the parody'; (4) Specsavers sponsors the wrong GTA; (5) lesson: don't pretend to belong, bring what only you can. One number on screen: 7 (patties). Avoid unit-sales numbers (sources conflict). Do not say Rockstar partnered with Burger King. GTA IV Heart Stopper ad has crude text: never show it. No AI-generated GTA characters, logos, Vice City key art or BK logo; real images only from owner uploads, framed and credited. Mockups: blank burger box/wrapper + official logo only if owner uploads it. Caption: sources + 'editorial use; images belong to their owners'. Never name the UAE, Dubai or any emirate.
